$Comment: The skeleton every Hallow's Eve quest at Old Jack inherits through Parent. It is Abstract, so it
Season keeps every child absent while Hallow's Eve is off, whatever Requires the child writes for
itself (an earlier step of the questline). Listing keeps each quest off open lists, so it is
offered only at Old Jack, and files it under the Hallows_Eve category, which reads "Hallow's
Eve" on a quest's page and in the book's category filter (its name is
quest.category.hallows_eve in the pack's lang). MainLine makes Old Jack's story quests main quests: a
list shows them first, with a gold bar and a star, while his dailies, which repeat, read as daily
whatever this says. Flow, Npc and CompletionDialogue are how each one
is taken, tracked and handed in there. Npc.TurnInId adds the report-back step to Old Jack to every
quest whose own steps hand nothing in. A child that writes its own Listing or Flow keeps every
leaf of these it leaves out. Flow leaves HideLockedSteps off, so the book lists every step of a
quest being carried, the ones still ahead under a lock, and a player sees what comes next, the
It carries no Requires, no Objectives and no Rewards on purpose: a child that writes its own
Requires.Factors drops an inherited gate, and an inherited step can be re-tuned but never
removed. The file sits outside the _Hallows_Eve folder so Parent names it the same way in the
game and in the build's content check.
